dialog: I'll show you the power of the Palanquin Ship!
Beginning our attack run. Full speed ahead!
Uh oh/ I've gotta hold on to something...
We'll soon make contact with the enemy.
Roger that/ begin the attack.
Wait/ are we really going to fight?!
Course we are!
Enemy ahead!
Let's try attacking them from here.
I want to learn how to command from a professional.
Alright! Watch and learn!
Looks like they're still near us!
Well then/ we've got to attack back!
The wind's back in our sails/ launch the counterattack!
Do unto others what they did to you/ that's the sailor's way!
Murasa/ there's not a soul around them!
Then let's start the counterattack! Bring the ship about!
At this distance we can catch up with them!
They're within our firing range!
We don't want to let them get away now.
Yeah/ I'm on it!
Skipper/ they're in firing range!
Fire at will!
We can weather storms even rougher than this!
As long as this ship can still sail/ we fight on!
We're losing propulsion!\n We're going to―
No/ we can still fight!
If we spread our fire/ some of them are bound to hit!
This will be plenty to keep the enemy in check!
Machine guns/ full auto!
This should be enough to hold them back!
Firing a spread of danmaku!
Auxiliary Spirit Cannons/ firing!
Spirit Cannons/ fire a volley!
Give 'em both barrels! Cancel that/ give 'em all the barrels!
Auxiliary Spirit Cannons/ fire!
Attack them with our Spirit Cannons!
Auxiliary Spirit Cannons/ make all guns ready!
Give them a full broadside!
Auxiliary Spirit Cannons/ make all guns ready!
I'll just let this take its natural course!
The target is ahead! Fire!
The main gun is firing/ keep out of the way!
Firing the main gun/ keep out of the way!
Now's our chance! Give them everything we've got!
The main armament is prepared to fire!
Bring the buddhist reactor to full power!
Mr. Kourindou/ it's ready!
Fire!
The main armament is ready now!
Targeting complete/ good to fire!
Fire!!!
Prepare to fire the Spirit Cannon!
It's ready!
Let's go!
Bring the buddhist reactor to full power!
Murasa/ everything's ready!
Sink down to the bottom!
Main battery/ prepare to fire!
Targeting complete/ good to fire!
Fire!!!
Concentrating all the ship's spiritual energy into the main battery!
Adjusting targeting... ready!
Hit them!
Captain Murasa left us this...
Firing the anchor!
Now's the time! All guns/ fire at will!
Power output rising/ we're ascending!
Drop anchor!
All batteries/ fire!
We'll secure the ship's hull in place/ then bombard them!
Dropping the anchor!
Concentrated fire!
Any ship that gets in our way will be sunk!
Eat this!
Concentrated fire!
Power output rising/ we're ascending!
Sinking Anchor!
Now's the time! All guns/ fire at will!
Time to attack from above!
Fire the anchor!
We've hooked them! Fire!
We'll secure the ship's hull in place/ then bombard them!
You won't dodge this anchor!
SINK!
Ram them with the Palanquin Ship!
All the way to starboard!
The enemy is directly ahead!
Rerouting all power in the ship. Emergency vernier thrusters active!
Faster than ever before! Go!
Oof/ this is way more acceleration than―
The targeting won't stay locked!
You can't rely on machines/ I'll do this by eye!
Shields/ maximum spread/ now!
Now's our chance! Fire all the cannons!
Withdrawing us from this airspace.
Time to use the ace we've kept up our sleeve!
Bring the vessel directly in line with the enemy!
Targeting confirmed!
All power to the vernier thrusters!
Palanquin Ship... Charge!
We can't keep up this acceleration for long.
There's a targeting acquisition failure!
I'll show you how we weather the stormiest of seas!
Go!!!
And then I press this button...
Bring us back under sail/ double quick!
We'll settle this with our ace in the hole!
Hard to port!
Distance to the target/ approximately five thousand!
Verniers activated/ everything's up to you now!
Prepare for ramming speed!
This level of acceleration isn't for a battleship!
The autopilot can't keep up!
All functions off/ I'll assume manual control!
Brace for impact! Maximum acceleration!
Spirit Cannons/ FIRE!
Give me a status report on the vessel as soon as possible.
Get the crew back on their feet!
We can't attack while at this angle...
We've got to bring the ship about/ and quick.
Even my Palanquin Ship can't counterattack...
Do they have higher performance than we thought?
Kosuzu! What's the range to the enemy?!
... Looks far/ Skipper!
Targeting systems show nothing in range.\n We've been had.
We can't fire back at this distance...
Then please take us to a position where we can.
We need to think carefully about when we're staying too far from the enemy...
Getting revenge is a phantom's specialty!
Gangway/ gangway! Any one idling around is liable to get hit!
We've come to provide assistance. Please give us some room!
Leave the rest up to us.
That was a good one!
Screen them with the Palanquin Ship!
Murasa/ let's screen them with the ship.
Bring the ship in between the enemy and our allies!
... Ichirin/ thank you.
Ichirin/ don't overdo it.
Ichirin/ I'll handle it from here!
Hide behind the ship/ you two!
Ichirin/ don't go overboard!
... I can't let your feelings go to waste!
Shou/ you're not fighting alone out there!
Shou/ don't go in too deep!
You're too far ahead/ Shou!
Shou/ this is no time for idling!
Nazrin/ even you'd do that for the ship?
Nice job/ Nazrin/ you're making it easy for us!
Nazrin/ leave the rest to us!
Nazrin/ don't push yourself too hard!
Oops/ Nazrin's so small that we almost ran her over.
We'll fight on in Keine's stead!
Keine gave us a good chance!
Keine made a window of opportunity for us!
It's actually quite novel to get to protect you/ Keine.
We should come to Keine's aid!
I know already/ I know.\n We got there in time/ didn't we?
No matter how stormy the seas we will prevail!
P- please/ don't steer so wildly...
No matter how stormy the seas we will prevail!
Yeah! You can do it/ Murasa!
You'll never sink our hopes!
You're the best/ Murasa!
Thank goodness...\n That attack's exactly the same as one in my knowledge.
Thanks/ Akyupedia!
Murasa/ they're coming in from starboard!
Roger that!
Murasa/ port side!
As long as I know where they're attacking from/ I'm golden!
Murasa/ they're above us!
Yeah/ I got it!
Murasa/ dodge to the left!
Roger that!
That's my Palanquin Ship for you! Absolutely dauntless.
How dare you scratch my ship with such a boring―
There/ there. Please don't make a fuss.
There's nothing to worry about if it's like this.
Yep/ let's keep fighting!
We've taken only superficial damage!
We did take a hit there...
Yeah/ but it's not significant at all!
Looks like it's not a problem at all.
The Palanquin Ship sure is something/ isn't it?
This captain is prepared to go down with her ship...
Please cut it out with the bad jokes/ okay?
I can't show my face to Hijiri after this...
We're still afloat! I'll show you just how tough this ship is!
At this rate/ even the Palanquin Ship is going to―
We're losing power from the buddhist reactor!\n At this rate/ we're going to―
That's not good! We're losing hull integrity!
I'll do something about it!
We've taken extensive damage!
Closing the bulkheads!
That's not good/ they really sunk their teeth into us...
I'll be darned/ even though the rudder works so well...
Aah!\n Can't we dodge around like everyone else?
We're a pretty sizeable vessel!
W- wow/ we're really rocking back and forth...
Skipper/ we'll be in trouble if we take more hits like that!
You don't need to tell me/ I'm trying!
A few more of those and we'll be in some trouble...
All hands/ brace for impact!
I've already been bracing for a while now!
The Palanquin Ship's not gonna sink like this!
I- is this normal?!
I guess I just don't have enough training...
Even the sutras have a few misspellings.
This is nothing compared to when the sky's dark and the sea's roaring!
We've taken fire/ but there are no problems with hull integrity!
Perhaps our battleplan was overly optimistic.
This is a good ship/ she'll be fine!
That's some good helmsman-ing.
I'm not used to getting praise...
Our flank is currently grazing!
We'll sail right through this sea of danmaku!
We dodged it... wait/ no/ we grazed it?!
We had to go to flank speed/ but we shook them off!
We're coming about hard/ hold on to something!
I have a contact incoming on radar/ please avoid it!
Thank goodness...\n That attack's exactly the same as one in my knowledge.
Thanks/ Akyupedia!
Wh- whoaaa!
Kosuzu/ keep your head down!
Murasa/ dodge upwards!
Taking evasive action!
Murasa/ they're coming in from starboard!
Roger that!
Murasa/ port side!
As long as I know where they're attacking from/ I'm golden!
We were protected by the power of Hijiri's Buddhism!
This is the full power of Myouren's Flying Granary!
At least for now/ we're safe and sound.
Barrier functioning normally...\n No damage reported!
It really is amazingly powerful.
We're fine as long as we've got our barrier!
Yes/ the Palanquin Ship is built quite sturdily/ isn't it?
How's the barrier's uptime?
Operating flawlessly!
Wow!\n So this is what a 'barrier' is!
Makes for smooth sailing/ huh?
I'll parry it... with my ship!
Here goes nothing!
Putting us ahead of the enemy. Ready!
Targeting confirmed/ we can intercept them!
We're gonna give you a REAL warm welcome!
Seize the initiative―This I command!
Aww...
Sorry/ this one is my fault...
I'm sorry/ Hijiri...\n I wasn't able to protect your place to come home to...
Our ride for Hijiri... sank...
This isn't good! We can't take this much longer...
We- we're done for. The Palanquin Ship...
She's a celestial/ huh. Seems like she has a rather warped personality/ though.
There's still not enough information about how you Celestials live in Heaven yet.
Maybe this can end up being some good publicity for the Palanquin Ship?
Closing off her line of retreat...
You're actually a youkai that isn't within my knowledge.
We'll stop you no matter what it takes!
Nue/ please listen to us!
If you won't listen to reason/ we might need to get rough...
You won't get away with this/ Mehko!
We'll stop you no matter what it takes!
We've got to face forwards!
Could this have been us?
I'm glad I don't have to write a Gensokyo Chronicle that reads like this.
It's like they're pure evil thoughts made manifest.
I don't want to see Hijiri like this!
Phantom or not/ I won't stand for this!
I'm not the sort who'd shy away from these kind of phantoms!
If you've gotten that down in the dumps/ I'll have to slap you back to your senses!
Oh/ now this one hits a little close to home.
Like I'd ever get like this!
Mehko/ please get out of our way!
I'm getting real tired of you. Sink to the bottom already!
Her spirit levels aren't high/ but...
What you're doing is far too dangerous!
Well/ I'd better make you give in a little faster!
If you won't go down/ then I guess I have no choice.
Mehko/ please/ let's stop this!
We'll be taking back Gensokyo's dreams!
Your dreams are sunk/ right here/ right now!
So this is what the dreamspirit fountain looks like...
I can't back down/ not when my beloved Gensokyo hangs in the balance!
I have a duty!\n I'm bringing Hijiri back home to Gensokyo!
I suppose this was inevitable. All that's left is to throw everything we have at you!
We'll be taking back the Dream World!
Your dreams are sunk/ right here/ right now!
I can't back down/ not when my beloved Gensokyo hangs in the balance!
I have a duty!\n I'm bringing Hijiri back home to Gensokyo!
I suppose this was inevitable. All that's left is to throw everything we have at you!
If we work together/ I'm sure we can manage!
Bring the buddhist reactor to maximum power!
Left full rudder... the target is ahead!
Target acquired/ directly ahead!
Cutting power throughout the ship and rerouting it all into the boosters!
Faster than ever before! Go!
Oof/ this is way more acceleration than―
The targeting won't stay locked!
Leave the steering to me! I'll do it by eye!
Now! Shields up!
Auxiliary Spirit Cannons/ make all guns ready!
The target is silent. Re-activating the ship's engines.
